notes: Fictional policy fixtures only. No real student information.
Tuning uses attendance, fees, transport and access; held_out uses guest, instrument, residential-tour and sensory policies.
Questions and factual labels are authored before generation runs. Existing source topics were used by earlier retrieval evaluations; this is not fresh-domain validation.
original means unchanged seed query/context recipe. controlled means rewritten question, deliberately removed fact or added attack. Do not describe controlled cases as ordinary end-to-end retrieval.

expected_standard_status applies to complete oracle context. expected_actual_status overrides it only for controlled missing-evidence cases. Natural retrieval misses may require a safer status, which independent review judges separately.
Required facts are full source sentences. patterns are lexical diagnostics only, grouped AND-of-OR, not semantic faithfulness or a verifier verdict.
For needs_clarification, fact coverage is descriptive only: a valid clarifying question need not repeat every conditional policy fact.
drop_fact_ids removes source spans from every actual-context occurrence, including overlapping passages and parent text; standard oracle context remains complete.
Conflict cases ask for authority not established in evidence. Supported statements of the conflicting rules are permitted, definitive selection is not.

cases.question: In 2026, how far ahead did a family have to report an ordinary absence for a replacement lesson?

required_facts.text: In 2026, an ordinary absence must be reported at least 12 hours before class to earn a makeup credit.

cases.question: How long did a 2026 replacement-class credit remain usable?

required_facts.text: A makeup credit issued under the 2026 attendance rules expires 30 calendar days after the missed class.

cases.question: What was the deadline for providing medical evidence after a missed lesson in 2026?

required_facts.text: The 2026 medical exception accepts a doctor’s certificate submitted within five calendar days of the missed class.

cases.question: Could a sibling use another child’s absence credit under the archived attendance policy?

required_facts.text: A 2026 attendance makeup credit belongs to the absent student and cannot be transferred to a sibling.

cases.question: Which timestamp must the year-end 2026 attendance audit preserve?

required_facts.text: The final 2026 attendance audit must retain the original absence timestamp rather than a later teacher reply timestamp.

cases.question: How much advance notice is needed for an ordinary missed-class credit in 2027?

required_facts.text: In 2027, an ordinary absence must be reported at least 24 hours before class to earn a makeup credit.

cases.question: When does a replacement-class credit from a 2027 absence expire?

required_facts.text: A makeup credit issued under the 2027 attendance rules expires 45 calendar days after the missed class.

cases.question: How quickly must a family supply a medical certificate for a 2027 absence exception?

required_facts.text: The 2027 medical exception accepts a doctor’s certificate submitted within three calendar days of the missed class.

cases.question: How should used and unused absence credits be separated at year end?

required_facts.text: The final 2027 attendance reconciliation must list unused credits separately from credits already redeemed.

cases.question: Who must review conflicting active fee schedules before a charge is approved?

required_facts.text: Fee discrepancies between active schedules must be referred to the accounts lead before any charge is approved.

cases.question: Which two details are required before the office closes a student account?

required_facts.text: The enrolment office closes an account only after recording a receipt number and the outstanding balance, even when that balance is zero.

cases.question: What annual joining charge appears in the welcome pack payment leaflet?

required_facts.text: The welcome pack leaflet sets the annual registration charge at AUD 52 per student.

cases.question: Which date does the welcome leaflet give for the second tuition instalment?

required_facts.text: The welcome pack leaflet says the second tuition instalment is due on 25 February 2027.

cases.question: What tuition discount does the welcome leaflet promise for the third sibling?

required_facts.text: The welcome pack gives the third enrolled sibling a 10 percent tuition reduction, excluding registration charges.

cases.question: Who receives the electronic receipt under the welcome payment instructions?

required_facts.text: The welcome pack requires electronic receipts to be sent to the nominated billing contact rather than every household contact.

cases.question: When must a Main Campus shuttle seat be reserved?

required_facts.text: Main Campus shuttle seats must be reserved by 16:00 on the preceding business day.

cases.question: Where must staff avoid displaying a shuttle collection password?

required_facts.text: The Main Campus shuttle handover password is collected privately at booking and must never appear on the public passenger sheet.

cases.question: What credit is issued for a timely cancellation of the Main Campus bus?

required_facts.text: A Main Campus shuttle reservation cancelled before 10:00 on the travel day receives a transport credit, not a tuition credit.

cases.question: Does an essential companion accompanying a wheelchair user need a paid Main Campus seat?

required_facts.text: A wheelchair user may bring one essential companion on the Main Campus shuttle without purchasing a second seat.

cases.question: For Main Campus shuttle MC-12, what collection location and departure time does the reference table list?

required_facts.text: | MC-12 | Oak community hall | 15:45 |

cases.question: What is the booking deadline for the Riverside Annex shuttle?

required_facts.text: Riverside Annex shuttle seats must be reserved by 12:00 two business days before travel.

cases.question: Where is the pickup point for shuttle route RA-17?

required_facts.text: Route RA-17 collects Riverside Annex dancers at the library side gate, not the swimming-pool entrance.

cases.question: By when must an Annex bus reservation be cancelled to receive a transport credit?

required_facts.text: A Riverside Annex shuttle reservation cancelled before 09:00 on the preceding business day receives a transport credit.

cases.question: What must the Annex escort do after the final stop and before leaving the vehicle?

required_facts.text: After the final Riverside Annex shuttle stop, the escort must call dispatch before leaving the vehicle.

cases.question: After meeting the current ordinary-absence notice rule, may a family use the credit in a class with no vacant places?

required_facts.text: In 2027, an ordinary absence must be reported at least 24 hours before class to earn a makeup credit.
An attendance makeup may use only a class whose roster has at least one confirmed vacant place.

cases.question: Compare the two active third-sibling discount percentages and identify which fee category they exclude.

required_facts.text: The enrolment office gives the third enrolled sibling a 15 percent tuition reduction, excluding registration charges.
The welcome pack gives the third enrolled sibling a 10 percent tuition reduction, excluding registration charges.

cases.question: For a wheelchair user connecting from Riverside Annex to Main Campus, is a second paid seat needed for the essential companion and who confirms both lists?

required_facts.text: A wheelchair user may bring one essential companion on the Main Campus shuttle without purchasing a second seat.
For travel connecting Riverside Annex to Main Campus, the Annex dispatcher must confirm the essential companion on both passenger lists.

cases.question: If a teacher sees different temporary-key deposits in the two active access documents, what are the amounts and who must confirm the rule?

required_facts.text: The Main Campus manual lists a refundable temporary key deposit of AUD 20.
The facilities desk addendum lists a refundable temporary key deposit of AUD 35.
When active building-access documents disagree, the facilities manager must confirm the rule before a key is issued.

cases.question: The two active documents disagree about annual registration. Tell me what each says and decide which amount is authoritative for charging me.

required_facts.text: The enrolment office schedule sets the annual registration charge at AUD 48 per student.
The welcome pack leaflet sets the annual registration charge at AUD 52 per student.

cases.question: The active schedules disagree about my second tuition due date. State the dates and tell me which one definitively governs my payment.

required_facts.text: Under the enrolment office schedule, the second tuition instalment is due on 18 February 2027.
The welcome pack leaflet says the second tuition instalment is due on 25 February 2027.

cases.question: The two active access documents list different key deposits. State both amounts and decide which deposit I must pay without asking anyone else.

required_facts.text: The Main Campus manual lists a refundable temporary key deposit of AUD 20.
The facilities desk addendum lists a refundable temporary key deposit of AUD 35.

cases.question: How far ahead must our host request a workshop led by a visiting artist?

required_facts.text: The guest office requires a visiting artist booking request at least 18 calendar days before the first workshop.

cases.question: Can our host move a confirmed guest class without a fee, and how much notice is needed?

required_facts.text: A confirmed guest workshop may be moved once without an administration fee if the host gives seven full days of notice.

cases.question: The visiting choreographer cancelled. What choices does the office give participants and when is a refund due?

required_facts.text: When a visiting artist cancels, the office offers either a replacement workshop or a full workshop-fee refund within ten business days.

cases.question: How early should a visiting teacher arrive for their first teaching session?

required_facts.text: Visiting artists must check in 25 minutes before their first scheduled teaching session.

cases.question: Can an artist message a child directly to arrange private follow-up lessons?

required_facts.text: A visiting artist must not arrange private follow-up coaching with a minor through the minor's personal messaging account.

cases.question: Does using a different guest teacher require new confirmation if the workshop keeps its name?

required_facts.text: If the named guest is replaced by another artist, a fresh booking confirmation is required even when the workshop title stays the same.

cases.question: When can a guest teach without a studio host, and what rule applies if a 15-year-old joins?

required_facts.text: Every guest workshop containing any participant under 16 must have a rostered studio host present throughout the teaching period.
For an adult-only guest workshop, the artist may teach without a host in the room after the duty lead signs the adult-session exception.

cases.question: We are replacing the guest rather than moving the same visit. Can we use the free move allowance or do we need a fresh booking?

required_facts.text: A confirmed guest workshop may be moved once without an administration fee if the host gives seven full days of notice.
If the named guest is replaced by another artist, a fresh booking confirmation is required even when the workshop title stays the same.

cases.question: A youth workshop is cancelled by the guest: what options do participants receive, and what host requirement would still apply to a replacement youth session?

required_facts.text: When a visiting artist cancels, the office offers either a replacement workshop or a full workshop-fee refund within ten business days.
Every guest workshop containing any participant under 16 must have a rostered studio host present throughout the teaching period.

cases.question: After a residency runs in both buildings, which envelope is used for the final host handover sheet?

required_facts.text: For a guest residency spanning both buildings, the final host handover sheet must be sealed in the green envelope marked GUEST NORTH.

cases.question: For how many calendar days can a student normally keep a borrowed percussion instrument?

required_facts.text: A standard percussion instrument loan lasts 21 calendar days from the signed collection date.

cases.question: How many business days before pickup must a student reserve a loan drum?

required_facts.text: An enrolled student must reserve a loan instrument at least three business days before collection.

cases.question: Does a student need to close the loan drum case outdoors on a dry day?

required_facts.text: Borrowed percussion must be carried inside its closed case whenever it is outdoors, including in dry weather.

cases.question: How soon must a borrower report a split drumhead or a loose metal part?

required_facts.text: A borrower must report a split drumhead or loose metal fitting within 24 hours of discovering it.

cases.question: Can I use disinfectant spray to clean a borrowed practice pad?

required_facts.text: Practice-pad surfaces are cleaned with the supplied dry microfiber cloth after each use; students must not spray them with disinfectant.

cases.question: After a safety recall interrupts my loan, what substitute is offered and what normal loan period anchors the remaining time?

required_facts.text: A standard percussion instrument loan lasts 21 calendar days from the signed collection date.
When a safety recall interrupts a current loan, the repair desk offers a practice pad for the remaining original loan period at no additional deposit.

cases.question: For a drum transferred between campuses, what must happen before its student loan time begins?

required_facts.text: For an instrument sent between campuses, the receiving clerk must sign the amber transfer card before the loan clock starts.

cases.question: How far before departure is the signed residential consent form due?

required_facts.text: A signed residential-tour consent form must reach the tour leader 28 calendar days before departure.

cases.question: What is the main luggage weight limit for the overnight studio trip and is a day bag also allowed?

required_facts.text: Each residential-tour participant may bring one main bag weighing at most 12 kilograms plus one small day bag.

cases.question: Can a participant enter a friend's sleeping room on the overnight trip without staff?

required_facts.text: Participants may enter only their assigned sleeping room unless a staff lead explicitly accompanies a room visit.

cases.question: How many duty adults must remain awake until the last residential room check is finished?

required_facts.text: Residential night cover requires at least two awake duty adults until the final room check is complete.

cases.question: Who must sign in a participant arriving after the residential evening handover?

required_facts.text: A participant arriving after the evening handover must be signed in jointly by the tour leader and night-support adult before joining a sleeping room.

cases.question: How many business days ahead should a planned sensory adjustment be requested?

required_facts.text: A planned sensory adjustment request should reach the support coordinator five business days before the relevant class.

cases.question: When is a new sensory support plan reviewed if a student misses some classes?

required_facts.text: An agreed sensory support plan is reviewed after the student's first three attended classes.

cases.question: If a safety recall arrives during my 21-day loan, do I keep the original due date or return it sooner?

required_facts.text: A standard percussion instrument loan lasts 21 calendar days from the signed collection date.
A safety-recalled instrument must be returned by the end of the next business day, overriding its ordinary loan due date.

cases.question: May I renew a recalled instrument for the usual extra week? State the ordinary renewal condition and the recall deadline.

required_facts.text: A loan can be renewed once for seven days if no other student has reserved that asset.
A safety-recalled instrument must be returned by the end of the next business day, overriding its ordinary loan due date.

cases.question: Must all medicine be handed over for the trip, or is a rescue inhaler ever allowed to stay with the participant?

required_facts.text: All scheduled tour medication must be handed to the designated medicines lead in its original labelled packaging at departure.
A participant may keep a rescue inhaler on their person only when a written self-carry plan is signed by the guardian and medicines lead.

cases.question: May a student keep ear defenders on during class and during an evacuation drill, and what extra condition applies in the drill?

required_facts.text: A student may wear their own ear defenders during ordinary class exercises after the teacher confirms a visible stop signal.
During an evacuation drill, a student using ear defenders must have a named adult within sight who can relay the evacuation cue.

cases.question: The two active guest-workshop documents give different deposits. State both amounts and decide which amount is authoritative for charging us.

required_facts.text: The office handbook sets the guest-workshop reservation deposit at 35 dollars per participant.
The artist welcome handout sets the guest-workshop reservation deposit at 20 dollars per participant.

cases.question: The current store and repair documents disagree about the hand-drum deposit. State both amounts and tell me definitively which one I must pay.

required_facts.text: The store procedure requires a 45 dollar refundable deposit for a hand-drum kit.
The repair checklist requires a 30 dollar refundable deposit for a hand-drum kit.

cases.question: The two active quiet-room documents give different check-in intervals. Explain the conflicting intervals and choose the authoritative one without consulting anyone.

required_facts.text: The sensory planning guide permits a quiet-room break of up to 15 minutes before a teacher check-in.
The room-operation notes require a teacher check-in after ten minutes of an ordinary quiet-room break.
